title: Potbelly Sandwich Shop — Forsyth Town Center Tenant Build-Out
size: Approximately 1,850 SF endcap at 3145 Ronald Reagan Boulevard, Suite 975A
timing: Potbelly's Cumming shop is expected to open around November 2026. Local reporting says interior construction planning was already underway earlier in the year, making this a near-term GC/remaining-subcontract discovery opportunity. Contractors should identify the active tenant GC and confirm remaining MEP, kitchen-equipment, fire-protection, millwork, signage and closeout packages.
source: North Atlanta Star / Tomorrow's News Today Atlanta

title: Market Place Boulevard / Sanders Road — Retail Center & Restaurant
size: 32,221 SF retail center plus approximately 2,000 SF freestanding restaurant on a 3.57-acre commercial component
developer: Private developer; approved by City of Cumming
timing: Cumming approved the commercial component in August 2026 as part of the Sanders Road / Market Place Boulevard redevelopment. No tenants, GC or construction start are publicly announced yet. This is an early relationship lead for site/civil, shell-building and future tenant-improvement contractors; monitor City permitting and developer filings for the first construction permits and GC identification.
source: North Atlanta Star — Cumming approval reporting

title: Rōti Modern Mediterranean — Forsyth Town Center Tenant Build-Out
size: 2,124 SF restaurant at 3125 Ronald Reagan Parkway, Suite 912B
developer: Rōti Modern Mediterranean / Forsyth Town Center (Fuqua Development)
timing: A PlanHub bid listing shows the Rōti build-out was already bidding with an August 17, 2026 due date. The opportunity is therefore better treated as GC-award and subcontract-package tracking rather than an early pre-bid pursuit. Identify the selected GC and pursue any unawarded HVAC/hood, plumbing, electrical, fire-protection, millwork, flooring and closeout scopes. The 2,124-SF lease was publicly reconfirmed September 11.
